accuracy.why: Every fact of the definition sentence is carried: annual, Ramadan, community («عوامی», N404), festival, organiser «شاہ فیصل یونیورسٹی» (N353), «الاحساء میں», first edition 2024 («پہلی بار 2024 میں لگا»). Nothing added. The approved rest unchanged. -1: the governorate not named as a unit (N92/N402).

nativeness.why: Short verb-final sentences; the doubled «منعقد» (proof 1, on-r1 3) and the flat «میلہ … ہوا» (on-05 6) are both answered by the idiom «میلہ لگا». Charged: the homograph «کفو» (on-r1 1, serious; the marks read as scare quotes) and the unexplained link between the name's meaning and the event (on-r1 2), both under rulings the line cannot lift (N351, N391, P17/N82) or facts the source does not give.

compliance.why: Names byte for byte (N351 key, N353, P2); no vowel sign (P17/N82/N391); Urdu letterforms; Latin digit 2024; balanced U+201C/U+201D; one «۔» per sentence; no loan beyond the admitted name; no «محافظہ», no «ایڈیشن». Checker clean.

fit.why: The definition tells the traveller what the event is, who runs it and since when. Charged -4: the name still stops a Pakistani reader on the season page (serious in both b24 reads, on-05 1 and on-r1 1); the remedy is the owner's (N406).

calibration.question: ev.kafu-nights.intro: "its first edition was held in 2024".
candidates: A «یہ میلہ پہلی بار 2024 میں ہوا» (stages 2–5)
A' «یہ میلہ پہلی بار 2024 میں منعقد ہوا» (round 1)
A'' «یہ میلہ پہلی بار 2024 میں لگا» (round 2, the proof's wording)
B «اس کا پہلا انعقاد 2024 میں ہوا»
C «اس کا پہلا ایڈیشن 2024 میں ہوا»
calibration.evidence: Stage 4: no approved noun for "edition" (events.notice «ہر بار کے انتظامات», ev.lomi.after.seoDesc «اگلی نمائش»); B officialese (role 02), C a loan where Urdu has a wording (P16). STAGE 7: b24 on-05 item 6 (minor): «میلہ … ہوا» flat, "we would normally say منعقد ہوا". ROUND 2: proof on r1 item 1 (should-fix) and b24 on-r1 item 3 (minor): A' repeats «منعقد» about seven words after «اسے … منعقد کرتی ہے», where the sources use two verbs. READERS SIDE BY SIDE: on-05 found A flat; on-r1 found A' heavy; the on-r1 reader's own «ہوا تھا» returns to A. «میلہ لگنا» is approved site Urdu (Qasr Muhairis «جب الاحساء میں میلے لگتے ہیں»). Risk weighed: «لگا» as "seemed" needs a complement; here it has none.
calibration.ruling_or_recommendation: A'' (round 2, replacing A'): «یہ میلہ پہلی بار 2024 میں لگا۔» — the set collocation for a festival taking place; answers both readers with one word; the organiser keeps «منعقد کرتی ہے» (as ev.lomi.intro «… یہ نمائش منعقد کرتا ہے»). A (flat) and A' (the repetition, weighed and refused) withdrawn; B and C stay refused on stage 4's grounds.
calibration.guard: For the proofreader, not machine-read: the clause reads «پہلی بار 2024 میں لگا»; no noun for "edition".
calibration.ruled_by: Judge round1, b24-ui (round 4), 2026-10-17; re-ruled, Judge round2, b24-ui (round 4), 2026-10-17

tm_pairs.en: Kafu Nights is an annual Ramadan community festival organised by King Faisal University in Al-Ahsa Governorate; its first edition was held in 2024. “Kafu” comes from an Arabic verb meaning “to be rewarded”: to earn reward and praise. Among the highlights of the nights is the “Ghabqa”, a popular meal and social custom held on the nights of the holy month of Ramadan in the Arab Gulf states.
